instruction: I want to block all cookies from third-party websites in Chrome. How do I enable this setting?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires blocking third-party cookies in Chrome. Similar complexity - navigate to Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data and select 'Block third-party cookies'.
